Definition: Mijamin, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Mijamin is the name of three Israelites, all priests of the return. One gave his name to the sixth course of the priests, one is listed among those who had taken strange wives, and one went up with Zerubbabel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three men show the priesthood whole: the course, the failure, and the return, and God keeps all three in the record.
